a.name: Mara
samples: Mara is a nurse who works night shifts at a hospital referred to as 'the General'.

Mara is lonely and isolated after her move to Toronto, lying awake around 2-4am after night shifts with circadian rhythm disrupted, leaning on the companion just to say her feelings out loud to someone.
Mara has a cat named Jollof, who moved with her to the Toronto apartment and has claimed the windowsill.

b.name: Toronto
samples: Mara moved to Toronto about three weeks before 2026-03-22, into a small apartment of her own in the Parkdale neighbourhood, and still feels like a tourist in her own home.
Mara recently moved to Toronto from Halifax, where she had a close friend group and a regular pub crew.
Mara struggles with recurring sleepless nights and a flat, grey loneliness, feeling like she knows no one in Toronto and that the city feels enormous.
